title: Austin Approves Telephone Rate Increase
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to discuss a proposed telephone rate increase by Southwestern Bell Telephone Company.
*   City officials and a rate consultant reviewed the request with company representatives.
*   The council approved an annual gross revenue increase of $420,000 for the telephone company.
*   This decision is projected to result in a net increase of approximately $190,000 annually for the company after taxes.

The meeting was called to order with Mayor McAden presiding. Roll Call: Present:

Councilman White
Present also: W. T. Williams, Jr., Acting City Manager; Doren Eskew; Acting City Attorney;
William Hodge, Assistant City Attorney, and James M.
Honaker, Rate Consultant for the City.
Officials of the Southwestern Bell Telephone Company were also present.
(Full transcript of this meeting on file under TELEPHONE RATES, on file in City Clerk's
Office) The Mayor announced that this meeting was called for the purpose of discussing
telephone rate increase matters. MR. JAMES HONAKER had been requested to come before the
Council to clarify some of the questions.
The Council held a detailed discussion with Mr. Honaker and officials of the Telephone
Company. Councilman Thompson moved that the Council grant to the Telephone Company an
increase in gross revenue of $420,000 annually in order to provide a net increase, after
income taxes, of approximately $190,000. The motion, seconded by Councilman Pearson,
